summary: This tutorial covers various view options in LibreOffice Writer for document management. It starts with explaining two primary views: Print Layout and Web Layout. To switch to Print Layout, you click on the View menu, then select Print Layout. For Web Layout, you click on View > Web Layout. Full-screen mode can be accessed via the View menu or by pressing the Escape key to exit. The tutorial also explains how to use the Zoom feature to adjust the display of documents. Options like Fit Width and Height, Fit to Page, and custom zoom factors allow users to view and edit documents more efficiently. Additional view layouts include Single Column and Book modes, which help in organizing and presenting documents in different formats.
